[EN] Intercepted Transmission
[ES] Transmisión interceptada
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Let's go ask folks."
[ES] "Vayamos a preguntarle a la gente."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Zolyn.
[ES] Habla con Zolyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Temporary Cave Storage
[ES] Almacén temporal de la cueva
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask if anyone saw where the archdevan sorcerer went.
[ES] Pregunta si alguien vio a dónde fue el hechicero archdeva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the Temporary Cave Storage and find the escaping archdevan sorcerer.
[ES] Ve al almacén temporal de la cueva y encuentra al hechicero archdeva que está escapando.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find a witness.
[ES] Encuentra un testigo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask at the west of the camp if anyone saw the archdevan sorcerer.
[ES] Pregunta en el oeste del campamento si alguien vio al hechicero archdeva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Wait...what are you doing?"
[ES] "Espera... ¿qué estás haciendo?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Head to the Skyshrine and confront the archdevan sorcerer.
[ES] Dirígete al santuario del cielo y confronta al hechicero archdeva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Good idea."
[ES] "Buena idea."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Tell Dougal about the archdevan sorcerer.
[ES] Cuéntale a Dougal sobre el hechicero archdeva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
